vibe: Architectural Luxury Light. Editorial, cinematic, pristine, deeply structured yet spacious. It blends the authority and clarity of Swiss typography with the moody, expensive feel of high-end editorial magazines.

rules: No full-screen teal gradients. Teal is an accent, a kinetic trigger used strictly for CTAs and hover states.
Always use pure charcoal (#0A0A0A) for headings, never soft grey.
Background must be #F9F9F8 (Off-White/Bone) for structural sections to provide warmth and avoid sterile tech feels.

scales.H1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-[5rem] tracking-tighter leading-none font-light

rules: Headings must strictly use Cormorant Garamond to enforce the editorial aesthetic.
Overlines and small interactive labels use Manrope with wide tracking.
Do NOT use Inter or standard geometric fonts for any primary heading.
Do not center-align everything. Use explicit left/right alignments to create visual tension.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_grid: MODE A: Tetris Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12
rules: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical SaaS designs. p-24 and p-32 are standard for section paddings.
Tension over Symmetry: Avoid standard 3-column Bootstrap layouts. Use bento-style spans like col-span-8 and col-span-4.
Optical Alignment: Never perfectly center elements if it looks visually heavy on one side. Balance negative space.
Cardless Architecture: Do not wrap content in floating white boxes with drop shadows. Use 1px borders or subtle background shifts (#F9F9F8 to #FFFFFF).

surfaces: Solid Backgrounds: Flat colors with hard 1px borders.
Glassmorphism (for sticky nav): backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F9F8]/70 border-b border-black/10.
No rounded corners. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px) to retain architectural crispness.
shadows: Use diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]) strictly for overlapping editorial images.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary is #0A0A0A with #FFFFFF text. Hover state switches to #3DDAD0 with #0A0A0A text. Secondary button is border border-[#0A0A0A] bg-transparent text-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:text-[#FFFFFF].
components.navigation: Minimal sticky header. Glassmorphism effect. Logo on left, navigation centered, Locale Switcher + CTA right. Must be z-50.
components.footer: 4-column grid. py-32 bg-[#0A0A0A] text-[#F9F9F8]. Massive logo typographic treatment.
components.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn based. Stripped of all rounding. border-b only or sharp 1px borders.

sections.EditorialHero: Massive serif H1, cinematic image right or bottom. Strict asymmetrical grid.
sections.SplitStory: 50/50 image and text layout. Image spans full height, text centered vertically in its column.
sections.PricingCards: Not SaaS cards. Editorial price lists. Clean tables, 1px horizontal dividers. Subtle teal highlights.
sections.CinematicQuote: Massive serif quote (text-4xl to 6xl), heavily indented, generous top/bottom padding.

motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for premium momentum feel.
motion.animations: Framer Motion for staggered fade-ups (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0). Duration 0.8s, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1].
motion.interactions: Hover states must be instantaneous but visually impactful (e.g., color inversion or sharp scale).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure black or charcoal (#0A0A0A) on off-white (#F9F9F8) for body text. Teal (#3DDAD0) must only be used on dark backgrounds or as hover states where contrast is maintained.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='corporate-nav-cta').

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use standard SaaS marketing templates. This is an architectural luxury site. Build with raw HTML, Tailwind grids, and immense negative space.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling at the root of the corporate layout.
Add 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts.
Use Shadcn UI components ONLY for complex interactive parts (Forms, Dialogs, Select), but OVERRIDE their default styles to be sharp (rounded-none), cardless, and border-heavy.
When applying overlays on images (like the Hero), use max bg-black/30 or gradient-to-t. Do not kill the imagery with heavy black filters.
Ensure the locale switcher in CorporateNav is perfectly integrated without bloating the header.
All components must be visually distinct but share the same underlying CMS section registry.
Add data-testid to every interactive button, link, and form element to comply with E1 constraints.
